prose: Bloomberg reports that Shanghai-based AI chipmaker Biren is raising about $515 million (HK$4.04 billion) in another share sale. Its Hong Kong-listed stock is down more than 50% from a June peak but up about 70% for the year.
The article is paywalled, so only the excerpt was read. The funds are described as helping bankroll the company.
highlights: Biren raises about $515M in a new share sale
Stock down over 50% from June, up about 70% this year
Shanghai AI chipmaker listed in Hong Kong
